paper.group_note: 随机样本。主题是 rGO 复合正极，电解液对比为 DME/DOL（0.5 M LiTFSI + 0.5 M LiNO3）对 DOL/OCTO 难溶电解液（1.5 M LiTFSI，不含 LiNO3）：溶剂、稀释剂、盐浓度、LiNO3 同时改变。两种电解液循环电压窗口不同（DME/DOL 1.7–2.6 V；DOL/OCTO 先 1.2–3.0 V、后 1.4–2.7 V），容量比较受协议差异影响。全部用 500 µm 锂。正极 rGO 比例对比（同电解液换正极）不属本表范围，未列行

DD.name: 0.5 M LiTFSI + 0.5 M LiNO3 DME/DOL 1:1
DD.label: 常规
DD.quote: As the SotA electrolyte, a 0.5 M LiTFSI (99 %, Thermo Scientific) and 0.5 M LiNO3 (99.99 %, Sigma Aldrich) solution in a 1:1 vol mixture of DME (99+ %, Thermo Scientific) and DOL (99.8 %, Thermo Scientific) was used as the reference electrolyte

DO.name: 1.5 M LiTFSI DOL/OCTO 1:1（无 LiNO3）
DO.label: 局部高浓
DO.quote: The SSE comprised a LiTFSI solution in DOL, and OCTO (>98 %, Apollo Scientific) was added as a diluent (1:1 vol) to obtain the final 1.5 M LiTFSI concentration in the SSE

descriptors.mapping_note: Li2S6 加入电解液本身（含盐）
descriptors.scale: Li2S6 饱和溶液颜色与 UV–vis 吸收（定性），及可配到的 Li2S6 上限（DOL/OCTO ≤ 0.5 M；DME/DOL 可配 6 M）
descriptors.unit: 序号（仅表次序；大=溶解多）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法（Fig. 5a–c）；作者引文献称 OCTO 溶剂化弱、AGG 多，本文未测 Li⁺ 溶剂化
descriptors.quote: In our case, it was found out that the DOL/OCTO electrolyte could not dissolve polysulfide quantities higher than 0.5 M Li2S6. On the other hand, for the DME/DOL composition, the polysulfide saturation limit is higher, and a 6 M Li2S6 dissolution was prepared

C1.desc: Li‖S 扣式（KB-0.3rGO，4.5 mg/cm²、E/S 7、500 µm Li、C/10；C/20 预循环 5 圈；两种电解液电压窗口不同）
C1.rate_note: C/20 × 5 预循环后 C/10；DME/DOL 1.7–2.6 V，DOL/OCTO 1.2–3.0 V
C1.quote: using a 13 mm diameter S@KB-rGO electrode as the cathode, a 500 μm thickness Li0 disk (China Energy Lithium) as the anode, and a Celgard® 2500 membrane as a separator between them. The electrolyteto-sulfur ratio (E/S) was kept in all cases at 7 μL mg−1

C2.desc: Li‖S 扣式自放电（KB-0.3rGO，约 2.5 mg/cm²、E/S 7、500 µm Li；C/20 预循环两圈后充电态静置 3 / 5 / 7 天）
C2.rate_note: OCV 静置 24 h → C/20 预循环两圈 → 充电态静置 → C/20
C2.quote: 2032 coin cells assembled using the KB-0.3rGO cathode (sulfur loading ~ 2.5 mgS cm−2) and the DME/DOL or DOL/OCTO electrolytes (E/S = 7 μL mg−1) were galvanostatically cycled following this protocol

C3.desc: 单层软包（20.25 cm² 正极，约 2.7–3 mg/cm²、E/S 7、500 µm Li、C/10；C/20 预循环 5 圈）
C3.rate_note: C/20 × 5 预循环后 C/10；各电解液用各自电压窗口
C3.quote: Medium-loading (around 3 mgS cm−2) and high-surface (20.25 cm2) positive electrodes were used along with a 500 μm thickness Li0 electrode (39 × 55 mm), with a Celgard® 2500 membrane as a separator, keeping the E/S ratio fixed at 7 μL mg−1

comparisons.author_judgement: DOL/OCTO 对 rGO 正极润湿更好、穿梭更少
comparisons.note: 两种电解液循环电压窗口不同（1.2–3.0 V 对 1.7–2.6 V），容量差含协议因素
comparisons.quote: Remarkable initial discharge capacity values at C/10 of over 5.3 mAh cm−2 (around 1200 mAh g−1) are obtained with the DOL/OCTO electrolyte … outstanding discharge capacity values are obtained for KB-0.3rGO cells, reaching initial values of 1062 mAh g−1 at C/10 (around 4.8 mAh cm−2) with 99.6 % CE

comparisons.point: 循环寿命（DOL/OCTO 第 100 圈保持 65%）
comparisons.author_judgement: DME/DOL 中 LiNO3 耗尽后锂暴露被腐蚀而失效；高载量加剧
comparisons.reason_quote: This salt creates a LixNOy-rich SEI layer on top of the lithium metal anode, and when LiNO3 is exhausted, the lithium metal surface is exposed and subsequently corroded leading to cell failure
comparisons.note: 两种电解液循环电压窗口不同
comparisons.quote: KB-0.3rGO cells showed limited cyclability of around 30 cycles due to the combination of the high sulfur loading with the elevated solubility of lithium polysulfides in the DME/DOL electrolyte … a stable cycling performance with a 65 % capacity retention after 100 cycles, averaging 96.3 % CE

comparisons.unit: V（充放电平台间过电压，越低越好）
comparisons.quote: Regarding the overvoltage between charge and discharge plateaus, in the first cycles it is higher in the case of the SSE electrolyte, but after 33 cycles the overvoltage of DME/DOL increases when LiNO3 is exhausted and Li0 unprotected

comparisons.unit: V（充放电平台间过电压，越低越好）
comparisons.val_src_A: 缺失（Fig. 6b；文字：第 1 与第 100 圈几乎相同）
comparisons.author_judgement: DME/DOL 中 LiNO3 耗尽、锂失去保护
comparisons.reason_quote: after 33 cycles the overvoltage of DME/DOL increases when LiNO3 is exhausted and Li0 unprotected
comparisons.quote: but after 33 cycles the overvoltage of DME/DOL increases when LiNO3 is exhausted and Li0 unprotected, whereas in DOL/OCTO the overvoltage in the first cycle at C/10 and the 100th cycle is almost the same

comparisons.point: 预循环两圈后 C/20（静置前，7 天组）
充电态静置 7 天后首次放电
comparisons.author_judgement: DOL/OCTO 静置后容量下降更多，但下一圈几乎恢复
comparisons.quote: This drop is more pronounced in DOL/OCTO cells, reaching up to an 18 % capacity loss for the 7-days resting time, whereas for DME/DOL the maximum capacity drop is just 5 %

comparisons.point: 静置 7 天后第 2 圈（不可逆损失）
comparisons.author_judgement: 差距没有静置后首圈看起来那么大
comparisons.quote: Nevertheless, this drop is almost completely recovered on the subsequent cycle, and the DOL/OCTO based cells suffer an irreversible capacity loss of approximately 3 % with resting time. This value is slightly higher than for the DME/DOL based cells

comparisons.point: 软包循环寿命（DOL/OCTO 取 2.7–1.4 V 窗口）
comparisons.author_judgement: DME/DOL 软包锂沉积不均、苔藓锂
comparisons.note: DOL/OCTO 在 3.0–1.2 V 宽窗口下只有 17 圈，仍长于 DME/DOL 的 6 圈；两者初始容量的倍率不同（C/10 对 C/20），未列首圈比较
comparisons.quote: Pouch cells assembled using the conventional DME/DOL electrolyte showed interesting initial capacities above 65 mAh at C/20 but they failed after 6 cycles … The initial discharge capacity of the DOL/OCTO pouch cell cycled between 2.7 and 1.4 V was 55 mAh at C/10, just a slight decrease regarding the wider voltage range, and the cycle life was noticeably improved, reaching over 60 cycles
